data.name: Hissan
data.gender_notes: Hissan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A place of safety and security, a fortress or stronghold. Derived from the Arabic word حسن (ḥasan) meaning beautiful, good, excellent. The name Hissan carries the meaning “Fortress, stronghold, refuge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hissan usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, stronghold, refuge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is a source of comfort, protection, and security. It suggests a strong character and a deep sense of loyalty and commitment.
data.etymology: Hissan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortress, stronghold, refuge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hissan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: حسان
in_arabic.meaning: إسم حسان يعني الشخص الحسن الخلق والوجه
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الحسن, الجميل, الشخص الحسن الخلق والوجه. ورد اسم حسان في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 20: 'وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جَاءُوكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَظْهَرُوا اللَّهَ فَوْقَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُتَكَبِّرًا' لا يوجد اسم حسان في هذه الآية لكن هناك اسم الحسن, و الحسن ابن علي بن ابي طالب رضي الله عنهم و هو من اشهر الشخصيات التاريخية في الاسلام

in_urdu.name: حسان
in_urdu.meaning: حسان کا مطلب ہے اچھے اخلاق والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسان ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے اچھے اخلاق والا شخص، خوش کردار، حسین چہرہ والا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا اہم کردار ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हस्सन
in_hindi.meaning: हस्सन का अर्थ है अच्छे चरित्र वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हस्सन एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से निकला है। इसका अर्थ है अच्छे चरित्र वाला व्यक्ति, अच्छे आचरण वाला, सुंदर चेहरे वाला। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और इसकी पृष्ठभूमि इस्लामी परंपरा में है।

in_pashto.name: حسان
in_pashto.meaning: حسان د ښه چلګر شخص معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسان د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې نه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم ښه چلګر، نیک سلوک، او ښکلی چهره شخص ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو په منځ کې مشهور دی او د پښتنو د کلتور او دود سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Hissan
in_english.long_meaning: Hissan is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It means good character, well-behaved, and handsome. The name Hissan has its etymology in the Arabic language and carries a rich history in Islamic tradition. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, similar names like Hasan are significant, referring to Hasan ibn Ali, a renowned historical figure in Islam. The name symbolizes positive personality traits such as kindness, beauty, and good manners, making it a popular choice across various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hissan" carries a powerful and deep cultural impact in the Islamic context, as it represents a place of safety, refuge, and fortress. This can be traced back to the early Islamic history where the Prophet Muhammad and his followers sought refuge in various places, such as the Cave of Hira or the City of Medina, which provided them with protection and security during their persecution. The name also symbolizes the concept of building a strong and stable community, which is essential for every Muslim society.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hissan" represents the innate desire for every human being to seek safety and security, both in this world and in the next. This is reflected in the Islamic belief that Allah (God) is the ultimate Protector and Guardian, and that He will provide His believers with divine guidance and support throughout their lives. The name also signifies the idea of being a protected and blessed individual, who strives to lead a good and excellent life, as mentioned in the Arabic meaning of the name, which translates to "beautiful, good, or excellent." This spiritual significance inspires Muslims to strive for excellence in all areas of their lives and to seek Allah's protection and guidance, ultimately leading them towards a more virtuous and fulfilling existence.

historical_references.reference: The city of Hisn Kasr was a significant fortress and stronghold in the Egyptian desert during the Fatimid Caliphate (969-1171 AD). It was strategically located to control the caravan routes from the Red Sea to the Nile Valley and was a major source of revenue for the Fatimid state.
historical_references.context: Strategic location for controlling trade routes

historical_references.reference: Hisn Al-Sham (Crusader Castle of Hissan) was a Crusader fortress located near present-day Beit Jala, Palestine, which was built between 1153 and 1157 AD. It was one of the Crusader's strongest fortifications in the region and was a major point of contention between the Crusaders and the Muslims during the Crusades.
historical_references.context: Major point of contention between Crusaders and Muslims
